# MasterVLSI

> Premier VLSI training institute in Bengaluru — RTL, Design Verification (UVM), FPGA, SoC integration, and placement in 30–45 days.

MasterVLSI is a Design & Verification focused VLSI training school. Cohorts are mentor-led, lab-backed, and aligned with what top semiconductor employers hire for. 5000+ alumni placed at Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, Synopsys, Cadence and 60+ other companies.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, program pillars, mentor manifesto, and cohort highlights.
- [About](/about): Institute story, campus location, accommodation, and connectivity.
- [Courses](/courses): 15 industry-aligned modules across RTL, DV, FPGA, SoC, CDC, IP, and flow automation.
- [Services](/services): Silicon engineering services offered to industry partners.
- [Placements](/placements): Hiring partners, alumni video stories, testimonials, Google reviews, and salary heatmap.
- [Playlists](/playlists): Curated YouTube playlists covering VLSI fundamentals to advanced topics.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides, interview prep, and deep-dives on chip design and careers.
- [Demo](/demo): Book a free demo class with a mentor.
- [Contact](/contact): Address, phone, WhatsApp, and location in Bengaluru.
